arm64.scope: Reusable production frame runner from retained first-frame return through every supported second-frame substep, post-loop filter, animation and actual return; every substep finish compared to original execution
limitations: Computed extra suspension stiffness is zero throughout this retained corpus; nonzero steering-burst calculations are covered separately, not by connected motion here
Synthetic initial state and animation assets; nonterminating original reset avoidance is captured at repeated state, not counted as a completed reset
Animation-start path with pre-existing flag820=1 not reached by this retained corpus
AI 0x46d240 and scripted 0x470560 controller calls not executed; explicit pending boundaries
Second-frame no-iteration and pending-controller paths stop before the frame-end tail; rider visual object absent
At most four first-frame substeps, followed by all executed substeps of the next frame
Visual object c90 absent; static wall callbacks only
Long histories and whole-bike acceleration/release parity remain open
